counter_evidence.text: The configuration-only checkout rollout at 23:42:48 does not coincide with the failure onset: PlaceOrder spans with rpc.grpc.status_code=0 succeeded at 23:46:23, 23:46:33, 23:47:24, 23:47:34, 23:48:31, 23:48:36, 23:49:16 and 23:49:37 (all after the new pod's 23:42:48 start), and the earliest observed error span is at 23:51:09.

Neither checkout nor payment was crash-looping: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total is 0 for both checkout pods, the new checkout pod is continuously reported by kube_pod_container_info, and payment's single pod keeps an unchanged uid for the whole hour.

The failure is not a latency or saturation effect: payment Charge error spans last 604-837 microseconds and checkout's client Charge error spans 1.5-4.2 milliseconds, and the error text is an application rejection ('Invalid token'), not a deadline/timeout message.

fact.text: checkout PlaceOrder server-span signal: ERROR rate was 0 from 23:15 through 23:51, then 0.0121/s (23:52), 0.0141 (23:53), 0.0254 (23:54), 0.0361 (23:55), 0.0333 (23:56:04); the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate fell to 0 at 23:55 and 23:56, so the span-status error ratio reached 100% while total PlaceOrder volume stayed at roughly the same low level.

Error-span increases over the 300s ending 23:56:04: checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 10, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 10, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge 11.25, frontend 11.25 each for 'POST', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' 10 each, load-generator 'POST' 11.25.

payment's own server spans for grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service_version 2.0.2) record otel.status_code=ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace '... at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'; span durations are 604-837 microseconds, i.e. an immediate application-level rejection.

checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge carries rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and otel.status_code=ERROR with description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and its parent reference is the oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span (rpc.grpc.status_code=13, otel.status_code=ERROR) whose description is 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

The checkout calls that precede the charge succeeded in the same failing traces, with rpc.grpc.status_code=0: oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert (currency spans carry otel.status_code=OK, shipping spans http.status_code=200); cart, quote, shipping and product-catalog server spans in those traces show no error.

checkout outbound RPC rates: oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code=2 first becomes nonzero at 23:52 (0.0112/s) and reaches 0.0333/s at 23:56, while Charge with rpc_grpc_status_code=0 drops to 0 from 23:54 and ShippingService/ShipOrder and CartService/EmptyCart drop to 0 from 23:54; GetCart, GetQuote, GetProduct and CurrencyService/Convert remain steady through 23:56.

payment Charge server-span status shares: ERROR 0 through 23:50, 0.00417/s at 23:51, 0.0125 at 23:53, 0.025 at 23:54, 0.0333 at 23:55, 0.0375 at 23:56; STATUS_CODE_UNSET 0 at 23:55 and 23:56, so essentially all Charge server spans in the last 5 minutes carry ERROR.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout shows a metadata_generation change 5->6 between the 23:41:04 and 23:46:04 samples; a new ReplicaSet checkout-59d79499c4 appears with pod checkout-59d79499c4-zj8fl (kube_pod_start_time=1794872568, i.e. 2026-11-16T23:42:48Z, kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total=0), while the previous pod checkout-6984fc74d9-jh5kd (start 1794868324 = 22:32:04Z) is last present at 23:43:04.

Both checkout pods report the identical image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635 (image tag 2.0.2-checkout), so the 23:42:48 rollout changed configuration only, not the image.

payment was not redeployed or restarted in the hour: kube_deployment_metadata_generation{deployment="payment"} stays 1 for every sample, and a single pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 (owner ReplicaSet payment-6f7bc865d6, uid d2ca1d0e-ae36-4c9d-a8d6-1140eab2984c, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87) is present from 22:56 to 23:56; among all otel-demo pods only the checkout pod transitioned during the hour.

The 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' rejection pre-existed at low rate: PlaceOrder ERROR share was 0.0083-0.0417 between 22:43 and 23:14 and 0 from 23:15, traces at 23:05-23:10 already show PlaceOrder ERROR with the identical payment charge.js:37 'Invalid token' message, and payment Charge ERROR appears in several 15-minute samples between 06:31 and 23:11 (0.0095-0.0298).

Frontend-side consequence is visible in the same telemetry: frontend error-span rate was 0 until 23:51 and rose to 0.1125/s at 23:56:04; frontend spans 'POST /api/checkout' return http.status_code 500 with exception '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', and frontend-proxy 'ingress'/'router frontend egress' and load-generator 'POST' carry HTTP 500 in those traces.

app_payment_transactions_total rate for pod payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 (labels k8s_deployment_name=payment, service_version 2.0.2) was nonzero through 23:53 (app_payment_currency=USD 0.0167-0.0333/s) and is 0 at the 23:55 sample for both app_payment_currency=USD and app_payment_currency=CAD.

flagd EventStream error spans on ad, flagd and recommendation are steady at about 1-2 per 15 minutes from 22:30 through 23:45 and show no step change around the incident onset; they are background, not tied to the checkout/payment failure.

hypothesis.text: Leading hypothesis: the fault originates in Deployment otel-demo/payment. Every grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server span since ~23:51 is refused inside payment's own charge handler (charge.js:37) as an invalid token, in under a millisecond, with no payment deployment, pod or restart change visible in the hour, so payment's token validation or a dynamically read configuration/flag is where the rejection sits; what made the presented token invalid is not established.

Alternative hypothesis not yet excluded: the configuration-only rollout of Deployment otel-demo/checkout at 23:42:48 (rel-20261116234248, new ReplicaSet checkout-59d79499c4, same image digest) changed a checkout-side setting that determines the payment charge token, so payment began rejecting every charge; this requires an unexplained roughly 8-minute delay after the new pod started and therefore remains unproven.

rejected_hypothesis.text: Rejected: a checkout container crash or restart loop caused the failures. The new checkout pod reports kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total=0 with no further ReplicaSet churn after 23:42:48.

Rejected: a failure of checkout's other dependencies (cart, product-catalog, shipping, quote, currency) produced the PlaceOrder errors. Those calls returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in the failing traces and their client call rates stayed steady through 23:56.

Rejected: payment latency, queueing or resource saturation is the mechanism. Payment's Charge error spans complete in 604-837 microseconds and carry an explicit validation error message rather than a timeout.

Every grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server span since ~23:51 is refused inside payment's own charge handler (charge.js:37) as an invalid token, in under a millisecond, with no payment deployment, pod or restart change visible in the hour, so payment's token validation or a dynamically read configuration/flag is where the rejection sits; what made the presented token invalid is not established.

Alternative hypothesis not yet excluded: the configuration-only rollout of Deployment otel-demo/checkout at 23:42:48 (rel-20261116234248, new ReplicaSet checkout-59d79499c4, same image digest) changed a checkout-side setting that determines the payment charge token, so payment began rejecting every charge; this requires an unexplained roughly 8-minute delay after the new pod started and therefore remains unproven.
Rejected: a checkout container crash or restart loop caused the failures. The new checkout pod reports kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total=0 with no further ReplicaSet churn after 23:42:48.

Rejected: a failure of checkout's other dependencies (cart, product-catalog, shipping, quote, currency) produced the PlaceOrder errors. Those calls returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 in the failing traces and their client call rates stayed steady through 23:56.

Rejected: payment latency, queueing or resource saturation is the mechanism. Payment's Charge error spans complete in 604-837 microseconds and carry an explicit validation error message rather than a timeout.

gaps: pod_logs is not integrated, so payment's and checkout's logs (the rejected charge token, flag evaluations) could not be read.

change_history is not integrated, so what release rel-20261116234248 changed in Deployment otel-demo/checkout, and whether any flag/flagd configuration changed around 23:50:30, could not be verified; the flagd pod flagd-d6485586b-xskfj shows no restart, but its dynamic configuration is not observable with the available sources.
Spans carry no request payload or credit-card token, so which component supplied the token payment rejected is unknown.

The onset is only bounded to between 23:49:37 (last successful PlaceOrder) and 23:51:09 (earliest observed error); 60-second range queries returned no series (status no_data, evidence 7efc1636-851f-4be1-bb06-cb3e1f33884e-t0:0163b012-5694-4192-ad96-3bc30918a14b and 7efc1636-851f-4be1-bb06-cb3e1f33884e-t2:dd408719-ae8b-48f3-94a1-1cf31539d60f), consistent with a scrape interval near 60s, so the exact switch time is not resolvable.

rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="payment"} returned no series (status no_data, evidence 27270fa4-32a8-45c7-9af0-8cd921f50f36-t1:b790d22c-2d33-43cf-b7b1-0b3073acc585), so payment server latency was judged only from span durations.
The query for kube_deployment_status_replicas_available/ready returned only metadata_generation series for checkout and payment, so replica readiness counts for these deployments were not verified.
kubernetes_state and change_history integrations are listed as not integrated; their absence is a gap and says nothing about entity health.
next_steps: Diff the environment/configuration of ReplicaSet checkout-6984fc74d9 (old) against checkout-59d79499c4 (created 23:42:48) for payment endpoint, card/token or loyalty-related settings, to test or discard the checkout-rollout hypothesis.

Inspect the payment service's charge.js token validation path and any feature-flag state consumed by it around 23:50:30, including flagd flag configuration revisions, to test or discard the payment-side hypothesis.
Retrieve pod logs for payment-6f7bc865d6-s8xt4 and checkout-59d79499c4-zj8fl for 23:40-23:56 to see the rejected charge request, the supplied token and any flag evaluation.
Confirm whether other order-generating clients (load-generator, frontend) changed their credit-card/token input near 23:50:30, since spans do not carry request payloads.
report.summary:
Observed: the alert is real and is 100% at the last samples. checkout PlaceOrder server-span ERROR rate was 0 from 23:15 to 23:51, then ramped 0.0121/s (23:52) to 0.0333/s (23:56:04) while the STATUS_CODE_UNSET rate fell to 0 at 23:55/23:56, so the ERROR/(ERROR+UNSET) ratio reached 100% (evidence 3e6f3f49-295e-4bf2-b1c6-5d3f58807471-t0:de2711d2-08a8-4271-89a5-5f8068924b32). Absolute volume is small: in the 5 minutes ending 23:56:04 there were ~10 checkout PlaceOrder error spans and ~11.25 payment Charge error spans (27270fa4-32a8-45c7-9af0-8cd921f50f36-t0:6efe3804-a89d-42f2-bc3c-b03d3af1e3ea).

The failing step is checkout's client call oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (rpc.grpc.status_code=2), and the rejection is generated by payment: payment's own grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge server spans record ERROR with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold', thrown at /usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13 in 604-837 microseconds (a9f9e81b-becc-4944-a4df-9ad29f6b708c-t0:7ba7c745-76b8-471e-9ae1-9669e42e90b0). Every other checkout dependency in the same traces (CartService/GetCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, ShippingService/GetQuote, CurrencyService/Convert) returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and ShipOrder/EmptyCart call rates fell to 0 by 23:54, consistent with the pipeline stopping at the charge step. frontend then returns HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout and its error-span rate rose to 0.1125/s by 23:56:04.

The deepest cause is not fully established. Two candidate triggers remain as hypotheses. H1 (leading, names Deployment otel-demo/payment): the rejection lives in payment's own Charge handling - every Charge since ~23:51 is refused as an invalid token, sub-millisecond, with no payment deployment/pod/restart change anywhere in the hour. H2: the only Kubernetes-object change in the window is a configuration-only rollout of Deployment otel-demo/checkout at 23:42:48 (metadata_generation 5->6, new ReplicaSet checkout-59d79499c4, pod start_time 1794872568 = 23:42:48Z, identical image digest), which could have changed what checkout sends to payment; but this is weakened by successful PlaceOrder spans at 23:46:23-23:49:37 (after the new pod started) and by an onset ~8 minutes later, at 23:49:37-23:51:09. The identical 'Invalid token' rejection also existed at 1-4% of PlaceOrder spans earlier (22:43-23:14 and traces at 23:05-23:10), so this error path pre-dates the incident; what changed the rate to 100% is not visible in the available sources (no pod logs, no change history, no flag-config visibility). Checkout's other dependencies were checked and were healthy.
